items.section: PSoC 4000T touch controller
items.arch: Cortex-M0+ (armv6m; /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang)
items.targets: components/touch/source_image -> production provider in a source manifest profile
items.summary: Production-route the complete 31-TU touch source image (15,560 B raw) and make every resident-ABI assumption an explicit, documented configuration instead of a hardware blocker
items.notes: Progress 2026-09-17: added components/touch/source_image/board_config.h and wired the Touch source-image builder/admission gates to read named flash/SRAM/FWPK constants and an explicit blocked resident/board-contract list. Regenerated Touch final/current receipts and project MIT license census. Focused Touch/readiness/license suites pass, and make source-only builds on macOS with the updated receipt. This remains todo because production_routed is still deliberately false: SCB1/MSCLP/SPCIF/GPIO/resident-DFU behavior still requires physical board evidence.

items.section: STM32G0 charging case
items.arch: Cortex-M0+ (armv6m; /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang)
items.targets: components/case/source_image -> production provider in a source manifest profile
items.summary: Production-route the complete 8-TU case source image (18,916 B raw) and make board-routing assumptions (vectors, GPIO/timer bindings, bank swap) explicit configuration with documented defaults
items.notes: Progress 2026-09-17: Case source image now emits a structured board_contract from components/case/source_image/board_config.h, and tools/analyze_g2_case_source_image.py plus analyze_g2_completion_readiness.py carry that contract through the persisted summary/component details. The contract names flash/bank/SRAM/stack/identity constants, confirmed IRQ slots, USART base evidence, unconfirmed defaults, and the four blocked board contracts. Focused Case/readiness tests pass. This remains todo because production_routed is still deliberately false: exact interrupt ownership, GPIO/timer routing, dual-bank updater handoff, and preserved identity copy-forward need physical-board evidence.

items.section: STM32G0 charging case
items.arch: Cortex-M0+
items.targets: 40,866 typed-retained case bytes not produced by the 18,916-byte source image
items.summary: Account for and reconstruct (or source-author) the shipped case image bytes beyond the candidate source image: data tables, strings, identity windows, fill; then make the source image the same size/layout or document the intentional divergence
items.notes: Progress 2026-09-17: tools/analyze_g2_completion_readiness.py now authenticates tools/manifests/g2-case-byte-accounting-summary.json and carries byte_accounting_metrics/buckets into the Case component details. The 40,866-byte typed_external_or_unsupported bucket is now fully attributed without residual opaque bytes: 2,120 gap-frontier bytes, 1,104 platform-attributed bytes, 25,314 function-map body-attributed bytes, and 12,328 function-map gap-attributed bytes; residual_zero_fill, residual_ff_fill, residual_log_string_candidate, and residual_unresolved_code_or_data are all 0 bytes. Identity windows in this application range are proven absent. tools/analyze_g2_case_byte_accounting.py emits an empty residual tools/manifests/g2-case-log-string-candidates.tsv with digest 4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945; the former string corpus is attributed by function-map gap evidence as first-party log/status rodata, not source-owned. tools/analyze_g2_case_residual_shape.py now proves an empty residual_unresolved_code_or_data frontier: zero rows, zero bytes, zero decoded branches/calls/targets, empty recovery/non-target/entry-candidate manifests, empty-list digest 4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945, and empty partition digest 8b8a0fb3dfaf65d7b832fa22e87151d7d6dbc06266643848b58dc61cded876df. This remains todo because the attributed function-map bodies/gaps and Case source image are not production-routed/source-owned; attribution removes opacity but does not replace reviewed source ownership or physical board-routing evidence.
